about: Melting data measured in an open-access article, read in its full text at Europe PMC (PMC13647430) and its supporting information (figshare). Table 3 of the article and Table S.8 of the supporting information give, for BHET (CAS 959-26-2, Sigma-Aldrich, grade MQ100 in Table 1, no numerical purity stated), the melting point 109.6 +- 0.5 degC (382.75 K in Table S.8) and the enthalpy of fusion 34.0 +- 1.2 kJ/mol, both measured by the authors (section 3.3: NETZSCH 204 F1 DSC at 10 K/min, sealed aluminium crucibles; the melting point is the peak temperature of the melting transition, not the onset; the enthalpy of fusion is the area under the melting peak). The QSPR and COSMO columns of the same tables are predictions and are not used; the terephthalic acid row is taken by the authors from Aspen Plus and is not used. Cross-check in the same table: DMT 146.7 degC and 31.5 kJ/mol, NIST 31.6 kJ/mol.
